programmes.programName: Fellow Programme in Management (Operations Management specialisation)
programmes.evidence: Full official 2025 FPM admissions release explicitly calls the programme AIU PhD-equivalent and lists Operations Management among formal specialisations. Full current Fellow Programme description states the academic research award is the title Fellow in Management after original thesis, external examination and final viva; 2026 official admissions page confirms FPM track recruitment.

researchDoctorateEvidence.evidence: Official full Fellow Programme description states AIU PhD-degree equivalence, a multi-year research programme, original thesis making new contribution to knowledge, external examiners and rigorous final viva, award of exact title Fellow in Management. This is a distinct research credential, not relabeled PhD or DBA.

limitations: Exact awarded title is Fellow in Management; PhD equivalence is documented but the credential is not PhD.

The 2025 official admissions release explicitly listed Operations Management; the current 2026 FPM page confirms ongoing programme recruitment but does not separately list specialties. Current specialty availability is therefore not independently confirmed.

branches.conclusion: Current full academic FPM page plus 2025 official admissions release establish original-research Fellow credential, AIU PhD equivalence and formally named Operations Management specialisation. Residential/non-residential are tracks of one Fellow Programme, not two awards. Wider current specialisation inventory/recruitment status requires adjudication.
Official MDI pages read are management-school programme pages; a full separate engineering/school inventory has not been assessed, so no negative branch finding is asserted.

sources.note: Full official current FPM page; exact Fellow title, original thesis, external exam and viva, AIU PhD equivalence.
Full official one-page 2025 release lists Operations Management as named specialisation and AIU equivalence.
Full current 2026 admissions page shows offered FPM residential/non-residential tracks with March 2026 application deadline; no inference of later intake.

limitations: Research-doctorate eligibility requires integrator review of non-PhD Fellow credential; do not relabel as PhD in public display.
The last explicit opened specialty list dates to 2025; 2026 full programme and admissions pages confirm FPM continues but do not separately enumerate specialties.
